name: Eastern Earthshrine
summary: The Eastern Earthshrine is an island ritual circle located within a lake northwest of Stormwind Keep. Established by the shamanistic Earthen Ring, it serves as a liaison point between the order and the leadership of the Alliance.

sections.title: A Shamanic Grove in Stormwind
sections.body: Situated in the quiet waters just beyond Stormwind Keep, the Eastern Earthshrine offers a rare sight within human lands: a circle of stone and elemental communion maintained by the Earthen Ring. While Stormwind is primarily a domain of the Holy Light and arcane scholarship, the Ring's presence provides the Alliance with a direct conduit to the elemental spirits and those who work to keep the natural forces of Azeroth in balance.

faq.answer: It is a ritual circle maintained by the Earthen Ring in a lake just northwest of Stormwind Keep, serving as a dedicated location for shamanic balance and alliance liaison within the human capital.
The shrine is maintained by the Earthen Ring, a neutral coalition of shamans dedicated to soothing disturbed elemental spirits across Azeroth.

faq.q: Does the Horde have a counterpart to this site?
faq.answer: Yes, the Earthen Ring maintains the Western Earthshrine in the Horde capital of Orgrimmar.

angles.text: For shamans visiting the heart of the Alliance, this island circle stands as a rare enclave of elemental harmony and communion amidst the stone streets of Stormwind.
The earthshrine gives Alliance leaders near the keep direct access to the wisdom and aid of the Earthen Ring.
